about_short_description.short_description: Stempad is a pen-and-paper tool for science, making writing and collaboration quick and easy.

product.name: Stempad Editor
product.description: A cloud-based text editor designed for scientific writing that supports various technical visualizations and formatting blocks.

product.name: Stempad Copilot
product.description: An AI assistant integrated into the Stempad workspace that helps users with summarization, problem-solving, and content generation for scientific writing.

product.name: Scientific Blocks
product.description: Modular content blocks within Stempad for adding specialized scientific elements like math equations, chemical structures, graphs, and diagrams.

product.name: Cloud Sync and Collaboration
product.description: A cloud-based service that enables real-time collaboration, syncing, and user management for Stempad documents and folders.
